meta.title: Approve the onboarding response and send for approval

args.goal: On the prospect's Onboarding Details evaluation screen, review the onboarding response and click Approve; in the Send for Approval tab, fill the Buyer Added Attributes form if shown and click Next; on the Vendor/Prospect summary, add a Category and Location and click Next; add remarks, confirm the approval workflow is triggered, click Continue, and stop when the screen shows that the prospect was sent for approval.

steps.note: Performs the complete buyer-side onboarding approval flow that has no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: The prospect has been sent for Approval

steps.note: Verifies the oracle confirmation that the prospect was sent for approval.
